info.name: HerCare API
info.description:
Backend for HerCare Women, a free period tracker inside the DBI app.

**Who signs in.** Users are DBI users: send the token DBI gave them as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. HerCare has no passwords of its own for users. The admin signs in with `POST /admin/auth/login` and gets a separate admin token. The two kinds of token do not work on each other's routes.

**Envelope.** Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`. Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...] } }`.

**Dates** are plain calendar dates, `YYYY-MM-DD`, never timestamps. Times of day are `HH:MM` in the user's local time. Send `?date=` (the phone's local date) wherever it is accepted.

**Estimates.** Predicted dates are always estimates and are never stored as history.

Guides: docs/mobile-integration-guide.md, docs/sync-guide.md, docs/estimate-rule.md, docs/admin-panel-guide.md.

Setup: set `baseUrl` (collection variable). For user requests set `userToken`: in local development run `npm run dev-token` in the backend folder and paste the result. For admin requests run "Sign in as the admin" once; it stores `adminToken` for you.

item.name: Is the server (and its database) up?

request.description:
Not rate limited. 200 when the database is reachable, 503 when it is not. Use it for load balancer checks.

Operation: health

item.name: Disclaimer, privacy text and whether HerCare is switched on

request.description:
Public: needed before anyone signs in (welcome and consent screen). Contains no user data.

Operation: getPublicContent

item.name: Check that your DBI token is accepted

request.description: Operation: getMe

item.name: Download all of the user's data

request.description:
A versioned JSON backup in the same shape sync uses (notes decrypted, deleted records left out). Still works when HerCare is switched off.

Operation: exportData

item.name: Permanently delete all of the user's HerCare data

request.description:
Deletes every HerCare record of this user (the DBI account is not touched). Cannot be undone. After this, `sync` returns `erasedAt`: any phone that last synced before that must wipe its local copy. Still works when HerCare is switched off.

Operation: eraseData
Operation: getSettings

item.name: Save the user's cycle length and/or period length

request.description: Operation: updateSettings
Operation: listPeriods

The same start date twice is refused (409 DUPLICATE_PERIOD, edit the existing one). An overlap is refused with 409 OVERLAPPING_PERIOD until the user confirms and you resend with `confirmOverlap: true`. A period can be at most 20 days; dates can be at most one day ahead of the server's UTC date.

Operation: createPeriod
Operation: getPeriod

Only this record changes. Send `endDate: null` to clear the end date. The same duplicate and overlap rules apply as when logging.

Operation: updatePeriod
Operation: deletePeriod

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
Computed from the recorded periods by the rule in docs/estimate-rule.md. It is ALWAYS an estimate. A phone that works offline must implement the same rule; docs/estimate-test-vectors.json lets you check it.

Operation: getEstimate

item.name: One month, with logged days and estimated days

request.description: Operation: getCalendar

item.name: Symptom and flow log, newest first

request.description: Operation: listSymptoms

item.name: Save the log for a day (creates or replaces)

request.description:
Replaces the whole entry for that date, so sending it twice is harmless. 201 the first time, 200 after. An empty entry is refused. Only the listed symptom names are accepted.

Operation: saveSymptoms
Operation: getSymptoms

item.name: Delete the log for one day

request.description: Operation: deleteSymptoms

On first use the user gets a copy of the admin's default items. After that the list is theirs to edit (max 30).

Operation: listChecklistItems
Operation: addChecklistItem
Operation: updateChecklistItem

Past days that it was ticked on still show it.

Operation: deleteChecklistItem

item.name: Which items were completed on which days

request.description:
At most 92 days at a time.

Operation: getChecklistHistory

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
Each day starts fresh (nothing ticked); earlier days keep their ticks.

Operation: getChecklist

item.name: Tick or untick an item on a day

request.description: Operation: setChecklistItem

item.name: The user's hydration reminder times for a day, with done flags

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
No amount of water is ever stored or suggested.

Operation: getHydration

item.name: Mark a hydration reminder done (or not)

variable.description: One of the user's hydration reminder times, HH:MM

request.description:
The time must be one of the user's hydration reminder times.

Operation: setHydrationDone

item.name: All three reminders with their status

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
All reminders start switched off until the user turns them on. `status` is disabled, paused, snoozed or active.

Operation: getReminders

item.name: The notifications the phone should schedule

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
Computed fresh from the CURRENT period history every time, so an edited or deleted period can never leave a stale reminder. After any change to periods or reminder settings (and on app start), cancel the phone's old notifications and schedule this list. Times are the user's local time; the server does no time-zone conversion.

Operation: getReminderSchedule

item.name: Turn a reminder on or off, pause, snooze, or change its time

request.description:
Settings that do not apply to a type are refused: `leadDays` and `timeOfDay` for period; `timeOfDay` for daily_log; `times` (up to 12, HH:MM) for hydration. `snoozeDays` 1 to 30 skips today and the following days; 0 or null cancels a snooze. A hydration reminder cannot be turned on without times.

Operation: updateReminder

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description:
Only tips that have been clinically reviewed AND activated are returned. While a period is logged (`inPeriod`), the tips marked "only during a period" are added. Activity tips are marked optional and skippable. Empty until the admin has activated tips.

Operation: getTips

item.name: Everything the Daily Self-Care screen needs, in one call

query.description: The phone's local date. Defaults to the server's UTC date. Send it so "today" is right in every time zone.

request.description: Operation: getSelfCareToday

item.name: Push the phone's changes and pull the server's, in one call

request.description:
See docs/sync-guide.md for the full protocol (cursor, paging, conflicts, deletes, erase, restore). Safe to repeat: sending the same changes again changes nothing. Accepts bodies up to 2 MB, at most 500 records per list.

Operation: sync

The admin is one predefined account from the server's settings. Five FAILED attempts lock the door for 15 minutes (even the correct password is refused meanwhile). The token lasts 8 hours.

Operation: adminLogin
Operation: adminMe

Counts of users, records and active reminders. A count of 1 to 4 is returned as the string "<5" so a small number cannot point at one person; show it as it is. Tip counts are exact.

Operation: adminDashboard

query.description: Only reviewed (true) or not yet reviewed (false)

request.description: Operation: adminListTips

New tips start hidden and unreviewed. Titles are unique within a type.

Operation: adminCreateTip
Operation: adminGetTip

Changing the wording (type, title, text or when it shows) of a reviewed or live tip CLEARS its review and takes it offline (`reviewReset: true`): it must be reviewed and activated again. Saving unchanged wording keeps the review.

Operation: adminUpdateTip
Operation: adminDeleteTip

item.name: Record that a clinician reviewed a tip

request.description: Operation: adminReviewTip

A tip that has not been reviewed cannot be activated (409 TIP_NOT_REVIEWED).

Operation: adminSetTipActive

item.name: Disclaimer, privacy text and the default checklist

request.description: Operation: adminGetContent

item.name: Change the disclaimer, privacy text and/or default checklist

request.description:
The disclaimer cannot be blank (20 to 2000 characters). The default checklist (max 20 items, unique ids) is copied to NEW users only; existing users keep their own.

Operation: adminUpdateContent

item.name: The on/off switch and default cycle values

request.description: Operation: adminGetSettings

item.name: Switch HerCare on or off, and set the defaults

request.description:
While `featureEnabled` is false every user endpoint returns 503 FEATURE_DISABLED, except /user/me, export and erase. The defaults apply to users who have not set their own values.

Operation: adminUpdateSettings
